translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: HECHOS
book.title: An t’ajbilab ax in t’ajamal an abathualechic

content: A Pablo in toc’tsiyal an jolbixtalab tin tamet a Félix

Ne’ets ca putun bo’ a q’uicha ti c’uajat a Pablo ti Cesarea, tam ti ulits an oc’lec pale’ Ananías ani i yejtselabchic ax u eyal c’al an Israel ani an ts’ejcaclome c’al an cau im bij Tértulo. Tam chich jaja’chic c’al an gobernador abal quin jolbiy a Pablo.

Tam ti chi’thachits a Pablo tin tamet an gobernador, tamna’ a Tértulo in ts’i’quiy quin jolbiy. In ucha’ a Félix: ―Pay’lom gobernador, huahua’ i le’ tu pitha’ i c’ac’namal yan, cum c’al a lej tsalpathtal huahua’ u lej alhua’ c’uajil ani u lej jun ejet c’uajil.
Tin ebal tata’ i huat’al lej alhua’ a q’uicha, huinat alhua’ Félix.
Yab ne’ets quin ohuey tin cau. Expith tiquin t’ajchi an alhua’talab ca ats’a’ an cau jahua’ hue’ nan ne’ets tu olchi.

I tsu’tal axe’ xi Pablo lej it’ixbethom. Ju’tamaquits ta ca xe’tsin u lej lehuaxbethom c’al an Israelchic c’al in exobchixtal. Pel i oc’lom c’al an cuenel axi ts’at’at c’al a Jesús axi pelac i Nazaretib.
Ma tu othnanchamal i tiyopanil tam tin ne’tha’ ca otsits taja’ i griegochic. Jats ti yac’ua’ ani ne’etsac qui t’ajat ts’ejca’ jant’ini’ tin ulal an ts’ejcath cau.
Ani an comandante Lisias mocol otsits tucu c’anchi. Tu tixc’anchi a Pablo c’al i tsaplab.
Taley huahua’ u uchan c’al a Lisias abal cu chich teje’ qui ulu an jolbixtalab ta tamet. Xo’ tata’ a ejtohual ca conomichiquiy a Pablo max yab i chubax an jolbixtalab axi huahua’ i ulal.
Ani an Israelchic axi c’uajat c’al a Tértulo jaye in ulu abal lej chubax in jolbixtal a Tértulo jahua’ in ulumal.

Tam an gobernador in t’ipchi c’al in c’ubac abal a Pablo ca cahuin. Tam in ulu a Pablo: ―C’al u culbetal ne’ets cu toc’tsiy an jolbixtalab ta tamet Félix, cum u tso’obits abal yanits i tamub a ts’ejcanchamal an cau c’al i lej huit’omtalab.
Ma lajuj tsab a q’uicha tin ultsits tihua’ ti Jerusalén abal cu c’ac’na’ a Dios. Ca conoy jun jitaquitsq’ui tin cuenta u xe’tsintal abal tiquin exlanchi u lej ey.
In alhua’ xe’tsinenec ti bichou Jerusalén, yab in xe’tsinenec c’al jita’ tin hueutsíx. Yab u t’ajamal ca xacueculats i inicchic ti al am pulic tiyopan ni tin tsacam tiyopanilchic an Israel.
Axe’chic ax tin jolbiyalac ni hue’ yab in ejtohual ti tejhua’methanchi max chubax an jolbixtalab.

Jahua’ nan ne’ets tu olchi jats an lej chubaxtalab. Ojni’ nan u c’ac’nal a Dios axi in c’ac’namal u biyal juntalchic jaye. Ojni’ u aynanchal an it bel axi uxnal c’al an jolbixchic yab chubaxcua’. Ojni’ u tala’ belal jahua’ thuchathits ti al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés ani patal jahua’ thuchath c’al in caulomejilchic a Dios.
U at Israelchic axi teje’ c’uajat im belal abal a Dios ne’ets quin ejtha’ an tsemelom. Nana’ u belalne. Ne’ets quin tala’ ejtha’ tim patal an inicchic max alhua’ ani max yab alhua’.
Jaxtam u junini’ lubal cu t’aja’ expith jahua’ alhua’. Ets’ey cu putu c’al u uchbil c’al a Dios ani jaye c’al an inic, ani antsana’ quin c’uajiy thacat u ichich ani yab jolbith.

Tsab ox i tamub in xe’tsinenec al pil i bichouchic, ani talbel in huichiy junil ti Jerusalén. In huichiy cu pithanchi u at juntalchic axi ts’ejhuantal i tumin ax im pithnenec cu huat’banchichic. Ani jaye jun t’ajat u bina’ an ts’acchixtalab c’al a Dios ti al an tiyopan.

Tats tin tsu’u talchic i Israel axi tal ma ti pulic bichoulom Asia. Expith in c’ale cu t’aja’ jant’inits in ujnamtal an Israel abal ca tsu’tat t’oquethachits c’al a Dios. Yab hua’ats yan i inicchic tam tin c’uajatac taja’ al an tiyopan, ani yab u t’ajamal ca xacueculats jita’.
Axi tin lej tsu’uchic ti al an tiyopan, jats jaja’ in tomnal ca chich teje’ tiquin jolbiy max u t’ajamal jahua’ yab alhua’.
Ani max i, tam axi teje’ c’uajatchic jats tiquin jolbiy max chubax in elchinenec jant’o yab alhua’ c’al an cuenel ts’ejcom cau Israel.

Expith hualam ne’ets quin uluchic abal yab alhua’ u t’ajamal tam tu tsapic ucha’ an ts’ejcom cauchic i cau antse’: Xo’ tata’chic a le’ tiquin jolbiy cum nan u belal abal a Dios ne’ets quin ejtha’ an tsemelomchic.

Tam ti a Félix in ats’a’its antsana’ jahua’ in ulu a Pablo, in le’ quin jilchits an cau ani tam pil a q’uicha ne’ets quin ts’ejcanchi. Jaja’ in alhua’ tso’obnanchi in ey axi ts’at’elom c’al a Cristo. Tam a Félix in ucha’ axi muthat taja’: ―Tam ca chichits an comandante Lisias, tamna’ jats ne’ets tucu lejquinchiye an cau tin cuenta a jolbixtal c’al axe’ xi inic. Tiq’uele ne’ets cu ts’ejcanchi.
Tam a Félix in abchi an cau an capitán quin beletnaye a Pablo ani yabaye quin t’ajat hualca’. Ca pithan an q’uij ca tsa’biyat ani ca pithanchat i tolmixtalab c’al in ja’ubchic.

Tsab ox a q’uicha talbel huichiy junil a Félix ti Cesarea junax c’al in tomquil Drusila axi pel i Israel. In abchi an cau ca chi’tha a Pablo abal ca t’iloxnanchat jant’ini’ an inic ti quim bela’ a Jesucristo.

Ani talbel a Pablo in t’iloxnanchi jant’ini’ ta ca bolith c’uajiy c’al in ejattal ani jant’ini’ quin alhua’ beletna’ tim ba’ yab quin t’aja’ jahua’ yab alhua’. Jaye in t’iloxnanchi abal a Dios ne’ets quin t’ajchi an ts’ejcaxtalab an inicchic tam quim bajuhuits am bijith q’uicha. Tam lej jiq’uey a Félix, ani in ucha’ a Pablo: ―Xo’ quit c’alets. Taye tam quin jolc’an ne’ets tu abchi an cau quit chich junil.
Cum a Félix in tsalpay hualam ne’ets ca pithan i tumin c’al a Pablo max quin hualca’, jaxtam ayquith in caniy ca chich a Pablo ca t’ilmats c’al jaja’.
Putunits tsab i tamub ani tam calejits a Félix ti gobernador. Ne’ets ca punuhuat a Porcio Festo. Cum a Félix in le’ ca exla ti alhua’ inic c’al an Israelchic, jaxtam in jilaye huic’chichic a Pablo.
